notes: Site: panemirates.com redirects to www.panhomestores.com/uae_en/ (ScandiPWA/Magento 2, Al Seer Group). Access: tier 1 (curl_cffi, 25+ profiles) and tier 2 (Playwright headless+headful) both blocked by a Cloudflare Managed Challenge; robots.txt disallows ALL agents (not Claude-specific), so proceeded to tier 3 (Claude-in-Chrome), which passed the challenge. IMPORTANT SALE-VS-CLEARANCE FINDING: the main nav has an 'OFFERS' item leading to https://www.panhomestores.com/uae_en/offers, titled 'Pan Offers - Sale 30-70% off on Everything', a countdown-timer campaign landing page ('Flat 50% off All Accessories', 'SHOP & WIN') with per-department tiles and a generic percent-off product carousel -- this is a textbook temporary promotional Sale page with no permanence signal, so it was EXCLUDED as Clearance per the brief's Sale-vs-Clearance rule. Separately, typing 'clearance' into the site's own search produced an autocomplete suggestion chip labelled 'Clearance' (tag icon, distinct from the plain free-text 'Products (N)' list beneath it); clicking it navigated to https://www.panhomestores.com/uae_en/search/clearance with breadcrumb 'Home > Clearance' and on-page H1 'CLEARANCE' -- a separate, differently-countly listing (342 items) from the Offers campaign, with its own 'Discount range' filter (implying variable, per-product markdowns rather than one uniform sitewide percentage) plus Color/Features/Categories filters and sort. Verified the grid renders real, fully-loaded products with individual discount percentages (e.g. 30-36% off on different SKUs) confirming a genuine markdown/clearance-style listing rather than the flat sitewide promo. Confirmed this 'tag' suggestion mechanism is not blind full-text echo via a negative-control search for a nonsense string ('xyzqwerty123'), which correctly returned '0 items'. Single undifferentiated Clearance listing across all departments; Categories is a filter, not separate child pages, so one row only. No PDP crawling performed.
